name: Bread And Bruises
source:
YOU PLAY AS ONE SIR KNIGHTS SQUIRES WHILE HE WAS ALIVE, WILL YOU SURVIVE? (PROBABLY NOT...)

A sidegame for Monster X Mediator focusing on ONLY room 004.

[From [url=https://headlocker.itch.io/bread-and-bruises]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一位骑士爵士侍从，当他还活着时，你能活下来吗？（可能不是……）

Monster X Mediator的一款副游戏，仅专注于004号房间。

[来自[url=https://headlocker.itch.io/bread-and-bruises]Itch.io[/url]]
